cohort: The study included 160 pregnant women aged 18-40 years with premature rupture of membranes (PROM) and gestational age >37 weeks.
finding: Vaginal misoprostol resulted in a significantly shorter time to active labor and induction-to-delivery interval compared to vaginal dinoprostone for induction of labor in women with premature rupture of membranes at term.
mod_finding: No significant difference was observed regarding the mode of delivery between the vaginal misoprostol and vaginal dinoprostone groups.
